response.sql: WITH trans_avgs AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg FROM trans_avgs), above_avg_trans AS (SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg FROM trans_avgs ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ta.trans_avg > oa.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg FROM above_avg_trans), with_calcs AS (SELECT aat.transref, aat.trans_avg, oa.overall_avg, aat.trans_avg - oa.overall_avg as above_overall, ka.kept_avg, aat.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg as above_kept FROM above_avg_trans aat CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST) as rn FROM with_calcs), tenth_val AS (SELECT above_kept FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10) SELECT transref, trans_avg, above_overall, above_kept FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 OR (above_kept IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT above_kept FROM tenth_val)) ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST, transref
